body.description: Conformance validation-surface reference. Same two surfaces as ref-scope-1, but each surface owns a required category: level is required and unscoped, so the banner surface and the whole marking demand it; authority is required and scoped to 'alt', so only the alternate surface demands it. Lets a case say which surface a fragment is and pin what that surface demands, instead of judging every fragment as a whole marking.

body.description: Settling conformance scheme. A whole is written in `line`, which writes the level, the handling and a review date; a part is written in `short_line`, which writes only the level. A HIGH marking is sealed by rule, so a part read in `short_line` gains a fact its view does not write. A part may not be above its whole, OLD_LOW is a retired spelling of LOW, and the review date is a calendar date stored as YYYY-MM-DD and written as YYYYMMDD.
body.name: Reference Settling Scheme 1

body.description: Conformance scope+capture reference. Three categories: level (default-scope, max rollup, required, in the banner format); authority (scoped to 'alt', union rollup, excluded from the banner but present in the full format); origin (scoped to 'alt', a capture-value concept whose {value} channel only survives the full format). Mirrors a common authority-scope pattern: alternate-scope categories and capture values drop from the banner projection but travel losslessly as assertions.
body.name: Reference Scope Scheme 1

body.description: Share-list conformance scheme. Two categories: level (max rollup, required) and share (intersection rollup, optional), so a whole can carry a share value that not every part allows. Parts are written in parentheses and run to the next part.
body.name: Reference Scheme 2
